units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 90:9">Targ. Ps. XC, 9</cite>.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 36b:7">B. Mets. 36ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳ דאגמא</he> the vapors of the marsh.
<cite ref="Shabbat 95a:5">Sabb. 95ᵃ</cite> <he>מצטער מה׳</he> suffering from the close air of the room.
<cite ref="Chullin 8a:7">Ḥull. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>ואתי ה׳ וכ׳</he> and the effect of the hot iron comes and removes the traces of the stroke; <he>ה׳ קדים וכ׳</he> the burn takes effect first &c.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 7a:23">Bekh. 7ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>ה׳ דבישרא וכ׳</he> it is the exudations of the body (which make the urin thick).
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 50b:12">B. Kam. 50ᵇ</cite> <he>דאית ביה ה׳</he> in which the air is injurious (v. <cite ref="E00042">preced.</cite>).
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 50b:16">Ib.</cite> <he>אין ה׳ למיתה ויש ה׳ וכ׳</he> the air is not bad enough to cause death, but enough to cause injury; a. fr.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 27:12">Targ. Job XXVII, 12</cite> <he>הֶ׳</he>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ecclesiastes 1:2">Targ. Koh. I, 2</cite>.—Pl. <he>הַבְלַיָּא</he>, <he>הַבְלִין</he>.
